title: MongoDB Core Values Posters and Stickers
summary: Posters, stickers, murals, and internal materials bringing MongoDB's company values into the workplace.
overview: I designed posters, stickers, and internal graphics that brought MongoDB's company values into the workplace. The visual language gave each value its own expression while keeping the full set recognizable as one campaign.

projectBrief.context: MongoDB wanted its company values to be visible and memorable across the employee experience.
projectBrief.challenge: Five distinct values needed individual expression without feeling like unrelated internal campaigns.
projectBrief.contribution: I designed the poster, sticker, mural, and internal graphic system for the values.
projectBrief.approach: I used a shared typographic structure with distinct color and composition choices for each message.
projectBrief.outcome: The work extended the values across office posters, wall murals, stickers, and other internal culture materials.
